about: What the shadow desk asks the answer engines, as a reader would: the bare question, no instructions, no date, no hint of our record. The fixed set is asked every hour in Portuguese and English; the zoom-in set asks about single decisions in our graph (data/decisions/graph.json). Questions are never reworded once asked: a changed question is a new id.
